title: An Adaptive Upper One-Sided Cumulative Sum Control Chart with Joint Parameter Optimization for Monitoring the Ratio of Two Normal Variables in Short Production Runs
summary: Monitoring the ratio of two correlated normal variables is increasingly important in statistical process control, since many quality characteristics are expressed in relative rather than absolute form. Memory-type ratio charts have mostly been developed for long production runs, while their finite-horizon counterparts rely on a fixed reference value $ k $ derived from a specified shift.
